thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High GPU memory pressure detected on pool-gamma (region: us-west2). Eviction rate 87%, cuda:alloc returned OOM in 3 nodes. auto-shedder triggered.

pagerduty: PagerDuty incident INC-2026-8745 fired -> @engineering-oncall. Notify policy: high-priority, 3-min ack window.

maya: acked. I'm on it. starting triage — which customers on pool-gamma?

sam: looking. matching inference jobs: model=rw-instruct-v1 (quantized), model=vicuna-13b. Traffic spike from a few heavy batch jobs from internal perf tests.

henry: I see nodes gpu-gw-03 and gpu-gw-07 showing sustained 96% mem and repeated cuda:alloc errors in dmesg. NV drivers OK. Possibly kvcache thrash.

maya: copying runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-memory (see section "hotwave"). starting mitigations: 1) pause incoming scheduled batch jobs 2) increase kvcache eviction aggressiveness 3) cordon and drain worst node if needed.

sre-runbook-bot: Runbook step: "Reduce kvcache size and enable aggressive prefetch backoff" recommended. CLI helper: `redwoodctl pool update pool-gamma --kvcache-threshold 0.4`

sam: running diagnostic logs now. tail of gpu-proxy on gpu-gw-03: ```
[03:12:11] ERROR cuda:alloc failed: out of memory
[03:12:11] WARN kv-cache: evicting prefix 82kB (rate 530/s)
[03:12:12] INFO prefetch: prefetched 64MB
[03:12:13] ERROR cuda:alloc failed: out of memory
```

maya: ok pause perf-tests job set and disable scheduled batches to pool-gamma. @liz can you check if any customer-facing requests are failing or timing out?

liz: support telemetry shows elevated 5xxs for customer org "ClipStream" between 03:10 and 03:20 UTC. Error signature matches `cuda:alloc failed` from inference proxies. I'm opening a support incident and notifying the account.

henry: I'm draining gpu-gw-03. command: `kubectl drain gpu-gw-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — starting now.

sam: lowering kvcache threshold to 0.35 on pool-gamma to force earlier evictions: `redwoodctl pool update pool-gamma --kvcache-threshold 0.35` — applied.

maya: rolling restart of inference-worker on affected nodes to reclaim fragmentation? yes/no?

sam: do it after drain completes. fragmentation looks high (reported slab fragmentation ~18%). restart should free up allocatable segments.

pagerduty: Incident INC-2026-8745 acknowledged by maya. Escalation to L2 if not resolved in 15m.

henry: drain complete on gpu-gw-03, moved ~12 active containers to fallback pools. Evacuation increased tail latency briefly but prevented further OOMs.

sam: running a targeted restart on proxy process on gpu-gw-07 now: `systemctl restart redwood-proxy` — monitors show mem usage dropping.

maya: good. monitoring metrics: eviction rate down to 24%, cuda:alloc errors dropped to 0 in last 60s.

liz: ClipStream reports partial degradation but most requests succeeded after 03:24 UTC. Sending customer update: "We mitigated a transient GPU memory pressure incident; some requests between 03:10-03:24 may have returned errors. We're continuing root cause analysis."

sre-runbook-bot: Suggested followups: enable prefetch backoff for heavy batched workloads, add longer-term slab-defrag schedule, and add alert: sustained eviction>50% for >2m.

henry: I'll provision 2 small buffer nodes in the pool (gpu-buffer-01/02) to reduce pressure during hotwaves. kicking off autoscale now.

sam: filing infra ticket to add a KV-cache TTL experiment and to tweak quantized model prefetch heuristics (LINK: https://redwood.internal/infra/ISSUE-3241).

maya: marking incident as under control. handing to infra oncall for follow-up and RCA. Handoff to henry at 03:35 UTC. Leaving notes: observed prefetched bytes spike correlated with internal batch tests; fragmentation likely contributed.

henry: taking over. I'll coordinate RCA and postmortem. ETA for full RCA draft 48h.

pagerduty: Incident INC-2026-8745 status: acknowledged -> resolved (under-control) in PagerDuty by maya at 03:35 UTC.

maya: :thumbsup: thanks team. action items: (1) autoscale buffer nodes (henry) (2) run KV-cache TTL experiment (sam) (3) update alerts for eviction window (sre). I'll follow up in postmortem.

liz: support to send final customer summary once RCA ready.

incident-bot: Thread closed for active mitigation. Add follow-up notes to INC-2026-8745 and attach logs: s3://redwood-logs/incidents/INC-2026-8745/
